en: Changed the resume command printed at exit of a worktree session: it uses `-w` and `-r` if the long flags do not fit the terminal. If neither fits a kept worktree, rows above it say where to run it
zh: 变更 worktree session 退出时打印的恢复命令：若长 flag 不适配终端，则使用 `-w` 和 `-r`。若保留的 worktree 两者都不适配，其上方的行会说明在哪里运行
